source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the FRU_ADP adapter record is the intended physical FRU and that its complete BMC WebUI data agrees field by field with the corresponding read-only IPMI FRU data and approved Project reference.
original_method: Discover the exact adapter Chassis/FRU member and IPMI FRU device, collect complete protected read-only Redfish, WebUI and `ipmitool fru print` evidence, normalize encodings and absent values, then compare all required identity/manufacturing fields without clearing logs or writing FRU data.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the adapter-to-Redfish/IPMI mapping and authoritative field matrix. Collection and normalization may be automated; an operator may confirm WebUI-only presentation and the engineer resolves legitimate encoding/source differences.
safety_requirements: Exclude the source's log-clearing step; preserve SEL and host evidence.
Use only read-only FRU commands; do not edit, write, initialize, reset or reboot FRU/BMC state.
Discover the Redfish member and IPMI device rather than assuming `/Chassis/FRU_ADP` or a default FRU target.
Do not use insecure TLS or expose credentials, serial numbers, asset tags or board identifiers.
Normalize padding, encoding, truncation and unavailable fields before comparison while retaining raw values.
Stop on ambiguous mapping or unresolved authority disagreement; do not retry against another device by guess.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, FRU_ADP member, IPMI device/channel, field matrix and protected access.
Collect complete redacted Redfish and read-only IPMI FRU outputs with timestamps.
Capture WebUI detail and normalize every required field without altering source data.
Compare to the Project reference and classify encoding, missing, stale and true mismatch cases.
Return raw/normalized evidence without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the adapter physical/member/IPMI mapping and source-of-authority rules.
Approve required fields, encoding normalization and redaction.
Review discrepancies and assign the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET may inspect one candidate but three projected fields cannot satisfy the complete WebUI/IPMI parity requirement; the URI and target are assumed and access is insecure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate and resolve FRU_ADP, collect its complete protected response and the exact read-only IPMI FRU record, then normalize and compare every required field plus WebUI.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_ADP, source WebUI path, explicit ipmitool comparison, readable/correct Criterion, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform exact-target Redfish/IPMI/WebUI three-way FRU parity with raw-to-normalized traceability.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected adapter FRU and BMC inventory implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, Redfish schema and ipmitool/IPMI interface versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor adapter FRU layout and Project manufacturing/configuration record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds endpoint/device discovery, complete fields, encoding rules, protected access and redaction while retaining both WebUI and ipmitool evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Redfish-only three-field response is partial and cannot prove IPMI or WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Adapter mapping, FRU layout/reference, IPMI target and authority rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong FRU selection can return plausible data; serial/asset content is sensitive and cached sources may differ in freshness.

project_override_considerations: A vendor FRU utility may replace a source interface only when original/actual methods, exact adapter target, approval, field-level equivalence and uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage are recorded.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/adapter identity and exact Redfish/IPMI target mapping
Complete raw redacted Redfish response and timestamped read-only `ipmitool fru print` output
Field-by-field raw/normalized comparison including encoding, absent and stale outcomes
Preserved logs, no-write proof and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require adapter FRU correctness and explicitly add IPMI comparison. The DeepSeek omission is not a Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The FRU_ADP purpose and read-only comparison are identifiable. Endpoint, IPMI target and reference are normal readiness inputs rather than permanent blockers.

review_improvement: Restores the Master-required IPMI comparison, binds both protocols to the same adapter and makes every normalized difference auditable without erasing raw FRU evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU data can be cached, encoded differently and exposed through multiple device IDs. A plausible Manufacturer/ProductName/SerialNumber tuple is insufficient unless Redfish, IPMI and WebUI are proven to refer to the same adapter and the complete required field set is reconciled against an authority.
